summary: Successfully tested Vendor Rating System and Enhanced Order Management features. All 16 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified for OrderDetail page (rating display, vendor info, order progress) and VendorProfileView (customer reviews section with stats).
critical_code_review_comments: Rating system correctly validates: 1-5 scale, buyer role only, delivered/completed status only, one rating per order
Vendor average rating updates automatically after each new rating submission
Order details endpoint returns enriched data with vendor, buyer, quote, rfq, and rating info
Confirm delivery endpoint properly transitions order status and triggers rating ability
Add tracking endpoint properly restricts to vendors only and updates order status to dispatched
VendorProfileView shows complete rating stats (overall, quality, communication, delivery) and recommendation rate
Individual reviews display buyer name, rfq title, date, review text, and detailed scores
seed_data_creation: Used existing test order order_8d45a1ea88d1 which was already rated with 5-star overall rating
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vendor Rating System and Order Management fully tested. Test order order_8d45a1ea88d1 is in 'completed' status and already rated. To test rating submission flow, create a new order and complete it first. VendorProfileView for vendor_68cfbaafb999 shows 1 review with 5.0 overall rating.
